# Vowz

> Vowz (vowz.me) is a wedding platform for couples in India and abroad: a wedding website builder, online invitation card maker, WhatsApp-first RSVP, guest management and planning tools in one place.

Vowz is built by AXPIR Tech India LLP, founded by Anooj Xavier. New accounts get a 7-day free trial with full access, then paid plans with regional INR/USD pricing.

## Key facts

- 250+ wedding website themes covering Hindu, South Indian, Bengali, Sikh, Marwari, Muslim (Nikah/Walima), Christian, Kerala, beach, boho, floral, rustic, classic, modern and regency styles.
- 900+ online wedding invitation card designs, shareable on WhatsApp.
- WhatsApp-first RSVP with meal and dietary selection, plus-ones and guest polls.
- Guest list with groups and tags, broadcasts, seating chart planner.
- Live venue photo wall and crowdsourced guest photo albums with moderation.
- Event schedule (Mehendi, Haldi, Sangeet, Wedding, Reception), countdown, travel and hotel info, wedding party profiles.
- Budget tracker, checklist, custom domains, multi-language sites.
- Wedding vendor marketplace (photography, decor, catering, makeup, mehendi, venues and more).

- [Home](https://vowz.me/): Product overview and features.

- [Online wedding card maker](https://vowz.me/online-wedding-card-maker): Create digital invitation cards.
- [Invitation card gallery](https://vowz.me/card-gallery): All card designs.
- [Free wedding tools](https://vowz.me/tools): Free planning calculators and tools.
- [Wedding vendors](https://vowz.me/vendors): Vendor directory by category.
- [Pricing](https://vowz.me/pricing): Plans and regional pricing.
- [Blog](https://vowz.me/blog): Wedding planning guides and invitation etiquette.
- [Showcase](https://vowz.me/showcase): Example wedding sites.
- [About](https://vowz.me/about): Company and founder.
- [Contact](https://vowz.me/contact): Support and business enquiries.
- [Affiliate program](https://vowz.me/affiliate): 25% commission for planners, creators and shop owners.
- [Franchise](https://vowz.me/franchise): Franchise partner program.
